reviews.title: 騙錢說有解讀
reviews.text: 在instagram 看到廣告，回答了很多問題最後出現付款才+下載app才能得到解讀，結果什麼都沒有，介面變成是找人聊天，沒有解讀，是騙人的，不要下載！！！！隔了幾天，這個app會自動進行再次扣款！不要下載！！因為他們有你的信用卡資料！會自動扣款！！大家要小心！
reviews.reply:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear about your experience and would be happy to help clarify the situation. 
Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, and we’ll be glad to assist you.

Holding space for your journey, 
Nebula

reviews.title: This app keeps automatically charging money. Don’t download it.
reviews.text: This app keeps automatically charging money. Don’t download it.
reviews.reply:
Hi, we’re sorry for the concern caused by repeated automatic charges. Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com so we can review your account, help with cancellation, and check your refund request.
Trust your path, Nebula
